files.title: SPPU M.Com. Sem-I Syllabus NEP Syllabus 2026-2027

units.title: Introduction to Management Accounting
units.topics: Introduction of Management Accounting, Limitations of Financial Accounting, Meaning, definition and evolution of Management Accounting, Scope and functions, Distinguish between Financial, Cost and Management Accounting, Advantages and Limitations, Study and analysis of Case Studies (Parle G Case, Ford Accounts Payable Case).

units.title: Application of Marginal Costing Technique
units.topics: Introduction of Marginal Costing, Comparison among Marginal Costing, Absorption Costing and Differential Costing, Features and Assumptions, Key Terms: Marginal Cost, Contribution, P/V Ratio, BEP, Angle of Incidence, Margin of Safety, CVP Analysis, Break Even Analysis and Graphical Presentation, Managerial Decisions: Fixation of Selling Price, Key Factor, Make or Buy, Product Mix, Plant Discontinuance.

units.title: Budget and Budgetary Control
units.topics: Meaning of Budget, Budgeting and Budgetary Control, Essentials and Advantages, Limitations, Types of Budgets: Functional Budgets (Sales, Production, Cash Budget), Master Budget, Fixed and Flexible Budget, Preparation of Flexible Budget and Cash Budget, Zero-Base Budgeting (ZBB).

units.title: Pricing Decisions
units.topics: Introduction and Factors influencing Pricing Decisions, Objectives of Pricing, Methods of Pricing: Cost-Plus Pricing, Target Costing, Skimming Pricing, Penetration Pricing, Transfer Pricing: Concept, Objectives and Methods (Cost-based, Market-based, Negotiated Transfer Price).

units.title: Introduction to Industrial Economics
units.topics: Meaning, Nature and Scope of Industrial Economics, Concept and Organization of a Firm, Objectives of the Firm: Profit Maximization, Growth Maximization, Sales Maximization (Baumol, Marris, Williamson models), Industrial Efficiency: Meaning, Determinants and Measurement.

units.title: Industrial Location and Regional Development
units.topics: Factors influencing Industrial Location, Theories of Industrial Location: Weber's Deductive Theory, Sargent Florence's Inductive Theory, Need for Balanced Regional Development, Industrial Imbalance in India, Government Policy Measures for Dispersal of Industries.

units.title: Industrial Finance and Policy
units.topics: Need and Sources of Industrial Finance: Internal and External Sources, Institutional Finance: IDBI, IFCI, SIDBI, SFCs, Commercial Banks, Industrial Policy Resolutions (1948, 1956, 1991), Disinvestment Policy, Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in Indian Industries.

units.title: Major Industries in Maharashtra: Working, Problems and Prospects
units.topics: Overview of Industrial Development in Maharashtra, Study of Key Industries: Automobile Industry, Information Technology Industry, Sugar Industry, Textile and Agro-processing Industry: Performance, Problems and Government Initiatives.

units.title: Sampling and Non-Sampling
units.topics: Meaning of Population, Sample, Sampling Frame, Sampling Errors and Non-Sampling Errors, Probability Sampling: Simple Random Sampling, Stratified Sampling, Systematic Sampling, Cluster Sampling, Non-Probability Sampling: Convenience, Quota, Judgement, Snowball Sampling.

units.title: Parametric and Non-Parametric Tests
units.topics: Hypothesis Testing: Null and Alternative Hypotheses, Type I and Type II Errors, Level of Significance, Parametric Tests: Large Sample Z-test, Small Sample t-test (One sample, Two independent samples, Paired t-test), F-test, ANOVA, Non-Parametric Tests: Chi-Square Test for Goodness of Fit and Independence of Attributes, Sign Test, Mann-Whitney U Test.

units.title: Index Number
units.topics: Meaning, Importance and Limitations of Index Numbers, Types of Index Numbers, Problems in Construction, Weighted Index Numbers: Laspeyres, Paasche, Fisher's Ideal Index, Tests of Consistency (Time Reversal and Factor Reversal Test), Consumer Price Index (CPI): Construction and Uses.

units.title: Applications of Microsoft Excel to Business Statistics
units.topics: Data entry and management in Excel, Calculating Descriptive Statistics using Data Analysis Toolpak, Creating Histograms, Scatter Plots, Trendlines, Performing Hypothesis Testing (t-test, z-test, ANOVA, Regression analysis) using Excel functions.

units.title: Introduction to Statistics and Business Analytics
units.topics: Basic Statistical Concepts: Statistics, Population, Sample, Parameter, Statistic, Levels of Data (Nominal, Ordinal, Interval, Ratio), Introduction to Business Analytics, Big Data, Visualizing Data with Charts and Graphs: Histograms, Frequency Polygons, Bar Graphs, Pareto Charts, Cross Tabulation, Scatter Plots.

units.title: Descriptive Statistics
units.topics: Measures of Central Tendency: Mean, Median, Mode, Weighted Mean, Measures of Dispersion: Range, Interquartile Range, Variance, Standard Deviation, Coefficient of Variation, Skewness and Kurtosis: Concepts and Measurement.

units.title: Statistical Quality Control
units.topics: Concept of Quality, Assignable and Chance Causes of Variation, Control Charts for Variables: X-bar and R Charts, Control Charts for Attributes: p-chart, np-chart, c-chart, Process Capability Analysis.

units.title: Decision Analysis
units.topics: Decision Making under Certainty, Risk and Uncertainty, Payoff and Regret Tables, Decision Criteria: Maximin, Maximax, Laplace, Hurwicz, Minimax Regret, Expected Monetary Value (EMV), Expected Opportunity Loss (EOL), Expected Value of Perfect Information (EVPI), Decision Tree Analysis.

units.title: Introduction to Business Research
units.topics: Meaning, Objectives and Types of Research: Basic, Applied, Descriptive, Exploratory, Causal, Empirical, Qualitative and Quantitative, Research Process, Ethical Issues in Business Research, Plagiarism and Academic Integrity.

units.title: Formulation of the Research Problem, Development of the Research Hypothesis
units.topics: Identification and Selection of Research Problem, Literature Review: Need, Sources and Synthesis, Formulation of Research Questions and Objectives, Hypothesis Formulation: Types, Characteristics, Research Design: Exploratory, Descriptive and Experimental Designs.

units.title: Data Collection, Measurement and Scaling, Processing of Data
units.topics: Primary and Secondary Data Collection Methods: Observation, Interview, Questionnaire, Survey, Scaling Techniques: Likert Scale, Semantic Differential Scale, Reliability and Validity of Instruments, Data Editing, Coding, Classification and Tabulation.

units.title: Research Report and Mode of Citation and Bibliography
units.topics: Types of Research Reports, Structure and Format of Research Report/Dissertation, Writing Style and Language, Modes of Citation and Referencing: APA, MLA, Chicago, Plagiarism Check and Guidelines.

subjects.title: Foundations of FinTech and Digital Economy

units.title: FinTech: Evolution and Ecosystem
units.topics: Definition, History and Evolution of FinTech, FinTech Ecosystem: Banks, FinTechs, Regulators, Tech Providers, Customers, Comparison with Traditional Financial Institutions, Global and Indian FinTech Landscape.

units.title: Digital Economy Fundamentals
units.topics: Concept of Digital Economy, Digital Transformation in Financial Services, Network Effects, Platform Economics, Data as the New Asset, Economics of FinTech Disruptions.

units.title: India Stack and Digital Public Infrastructure
units.topics: Architecture of India Stack: Identity (Aadhaar), Payments (UPI), Data Empowerment (Account Aggregator, DigiLocker), Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC), OCEN (Open Credit Enablement Network), Global Impact of India Stack.

units.title: FinTech Verticals and Business Models
units.topics: Key Verticals: Digital Payments, Alternative Lending (P2P, BNPL), InsurTech, WealthTech, Neobanking, Crowdfunding, Revenue Models and Monetization Strategies.

units.title: Regulation, Ethics and Future of FinTech
units.topics: Regulatory Landscape in India: RBI Guidelines, Regulatory Sandboxes, Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, Cybersecurity and Financial Consumer Protection, Ethical Considerations in AI and Data Privacy, Emerging Trends: CBDC, Web3, Generative AI in Finance.

subjects.title: Digital Payment Systems and UPI Ecosystem

units.title: Payment Systems Architecture
units.topics: Overview of Payment Infrastructure in India, NPCI and its Role, RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, NACH, APBS, Payment Gateways and Aggregators: Architecture, Integration and Workflow, Card Payments: RuPay, Visa, MasterCard networks.

units.title: UPI Ecosystem & Emerging Innovations
units.topics: UPI Architecture, Protocol and Participants, UPI 2.0 Features: Mandates, Overdraft, Invoicing, QR Codes, Cross-Border UPI, Offline UPI (UPI 123Pay, UPI Lite), Interoperability and Digital Rupee (e-Rupee) Integration.

units.title: Regulation, Security & Fraud Prevention
units.topics: Payment and Settlement Systems Act 2007, RBI Guidelines on Digital Payments, Security Protocols: 2FA, Tokenization, Encryption, Common Cyber Frauds in Payments and Prevention Mechanisms, Dispute Resolution and Ombudsman Scheme.

subjects.title: Financial Data Analytics using Excel and Power BI

units.title: Advanced Excel for Finance
units.topics: Advanced Financial Functions (NPV, IRR, XIRR, PMT, FV), Data Manipulation with INDEX-MATCH, XLOOKUP, Nested IFs, Pivot Tables and Slicers, What-If Analysis (Goal Seek, Scenario Manager, Data Tables).

units.title: Financial Modelling in Excel
units.topics: Building 3-Statement Financial Models (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow), Forecasting Techniques, Valuation Models (Discounted Cash Flow - DCF), Loan Amortization Schedules and Sensitivity Analysis.

units.title: Power BI for Financial Analytics
units.topics: Introduction to Power BI Desktop, Connecting Data Sources, Power Query for Data Transformation and Cleaning, Data Modelling and Relationships, Basic DAX (Calculated Columns, Measures, Time Intelligence Functions).

units.title: Applied FinTech Data Projects
units.topics: Designing Interactive Financial Dashboards in Power BI: Loan Portfolio Analysis, Payment Transaction Analytics, Customer Churn and Risk Scorecard Visualizations, Publishing and Sharing Reports.

files.title: NEP 2020 SPPU M.Com. Sem-I and II Income Tax Act 2025 Revised Syllabus 2025 Pattern wef AY 2026-2027

units.title: Preliminary
units.topics: Important definitions under Income Tax Act, Basis of charge, Scope of total income, Incomes which do not form part of total income, Heads of income.

units.title: Income from Salary
units.topics: Provisions relating to income under the head Salary, Deductions from salary, Basic numerical problems or/and computation of income under the head Salaries.

units.title: Income from House Property
units.topics: Provisions relating to income under the head Income from House Property, Annual value determination, Deductions from house property, Basic numerical problems on computation of income from house property.

units.title: Profits and Gains of Business or Profession
units.topics: Provisions relating to income under the head Profits and Gains of Business or Profession, Allowable and disallowable deductions, Basic numerical problems on computation of income from business or profession.

units.title: Capital Gains
units.topics: Provisions relating to Income from Capital Gains, Short-term and long-term capital gains, Computation of capital gains, Exemptions under sections 54, 54B, 54EC, 54F, Basic numerical problems.

units.title: Income from Other Sources
units.topics: Provisions relating to Income from Other Sources, Specific and general incomes chargeable under this head, Deductions allowed, Basic numerical problems on computation of income from other sources.

units.title: Income Tax Authorities, Jurisdiction and Functions
units.topics: Income tax authorities, Appointment and control, Jurisdiction of income tax authorities, Exercise of jurisdiction, Competency of authority, Powers and functions of authorities.

units.title: Powers
units.topics: Discovery, production of evidence, Search and seizure, Power of requisition, Books of accounts, Inquiries, Survey, Power to inspect registers of companies, Faceless collection of information.

units.title: Return of Income
units.topics: Allotment of Permanent Account Number (PAN), Filing of return of income, Tax Return Preparers Scheme, Return by whom to be signed, Defective return, Self-assessment, Assessment procedures: Summary assessment, Scrutiny assessment, Best judgment assessment, Faceless assessment.

units.title: Clubbing of Income and Aggregate of Income
units.topics: Income of other persons included in assessee's total income, Clubbing of income of spouse, minor child, son's wife, Cross transfers, Aggregate of income, Cash credits, Unexplained investments, Unexplained money, Amount of investments not fully disclosed.

units.title: Set Off, Carry Forward and Set Off of Losses
units.topics: Set off of loss from one source against income from another source under same head, Set off of loss from one head against income from another head, Carry forward and set off of loss from house property, business loss, speculation loss, capital loss, loss from activity of owning and maintaining race horses.

units.title: Deductions to be made in computing Total Income
units.topics: Deductions in respect of certain payments: Section 80C, 80CCC, 80CCD, 80D, 80DD, 80DDB, 80E, 80G, 80GG, Deductions in respect of certain incomes: 80TTA, 80TTB, 80U, Computation of total income and tax liability of individuals.

units.title: Collection and Advance Payment of Tax
units.topics: Deduction of tax at source (TDS): Salaries, interest, contract payments, professional fees, Collection of tax at source (TCS), Advance payment of tax: Liability, installments, due dates, computation, Interest payable under sections 234A, 234B, 234C, Refunds.
